troubleshooting: If 86Voice is not sure, it should ask you to choose before saving.

matches.title: How do Personal Reminders work?

sections.title: Short answer
body: Open [[Back Office|back-office]] for restaurant-level review tools.

sections.title: What it is not

matches.title: Where do I find things in 86 Chaos?
matches.summary: Use the main menu and search. Common work is grouped by the job you are trying to do.

sections.title: Short answer
body: Open the menu, then choose the area that matches your work.

sections.title: Common places
steps: Use Today for daily notes and Need Attention.
Use Time Clock & Schedule for shifts, clocking in, Request Off, and Availability.
Use Inventory for counts, invoices, vendors, and orders.
Use Prep & Tasks for prep lists and checklists.
Use Help when you are not sure where to start.

matches.title: What are Custom Shifts?
matches.summary: Custom Shifts are saved shift presets for one restaurant. They help managers add the same kind of shift without typing the times every time.
commonQuestions: Where did my saved shifts go?

sections.title: Short answer
body: Custom Shifts are reusable shift buttons inside [[Schedule Builder|schedule-builder]]. They are shared for that restaurant with people who can use Schedule Builder.

sections.title: Who can use this
body: Managers, owners, and other people with Schedule Builder permission can use shared Custom Shifts. Staff who only view their own schedule cannot edit them.

sections.title: What you should see
body: When a Custom Shift is saved for the restaurant, it should appear on desktop, phone, tablet, and any fresh browser session for the same workspace.

troubleshooting: Make sure you are in the right restaurant workspace.
Ask a manager or owner to confirm you have Schedule Builder access.

matches.title: Why aren’t my saved Custom Shifts on my phone?
matches.summary: Custom Shifts should sync through the restaurant workspace so authorized managers can see them on other devices.
commonQuestions: Why are saved shifts missing on my phone?
Why are custom shifts not on mobile?
Where did my custom shifts go?

sections.title: Short answer
body: Custom Shifts are shared for the restaurant. Open the same workspace on your phone and refresh [[Schedule Builder|schedule-builder]].

sections.title: Try this
steps: Make sure the phone is signed into the same restaurant workspace.
Open [[Schedule Builder|schedule-builder]].
Wait for the Custom Shift list to finish loading.
Refresh once if the list still looks old.
Ask a manager or owner to confirm the shift was saved successfully.

sections.title: If it still does not show
body: The app may be using a last-known list while it reconnects. Do not create duplicates until the shared list loads.

troubleshooting: A saved Custom Shift is shared only inside the restaurant where it was created.

matches.title: How do HR & Training tools work?
matches.summary: HR & Training helps organize training records and certifications.

sections.title: Short answer
body: Open [[HR & Training|hr-training]] to review employee training items and certifications.

sections.title: Important
body: Follow your restaurant policy and local employment requirements. 86 Chaos helps organize records; it does not replace legal advice.
